question: ______ is a deep red soil found in tropical regions and often developed on mafic igneous bedrock.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laterite.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laterite**__ 

 __
 
• **Laterite is both a soil and a rock type rich in iron and aluminium and is commonly considered to have formed in hot and wet tropical areas.**
 
• All laterites are of rusty-red colouration, because of high iron oxide content.
 
• Historically, laterite was cut into brick-like shapes and used in monument buildings.
 
• Locally available laterites have been used in an acid solution.
 
• **Laterite soils have a high cay content.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Saline**__

 __
 
• **The surface layers of saline soil commonly have very good soil structure.**
 
• In terms of agricultural use, saline soil is one that inhibits the growth of most crops because of the higher concentration of neutral soluble salts in it.
 
• The salinity of the soil is measured by electrical conductivity.
 
 
 
• **Arid Soil**__ 
 __
 
• **Arid soils are the soils of desert or semi-desert regions and colours varies from red to brown.**
 
• The soil has a sandy texture and salinity.
 
• After irrigation, its productivity is increased and it becomes suitable for cultivation.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Pedocal**__

 
 
• 
 
**Pedocal is a subdivision of the zonal soil order.**

 
 
• 
 
It is a class of soil that forms in semiarid and arid regions.

 
 
• 
 
It is rich in calcium carbonate and has low soil organic matter.
